Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to dance and play with her friends. One day, Lucy found an umbrella in her yard. The umbrella had a picture of a big, red ball. Lucy wanted to show her friends the ball, so she ran back to her house and took the ball outside.
As Lucy opened the umbrella, she saw her friend, Sam, holding the ball. Sam wanted to play with the ball too. But he was too little to ask. Lucy felt sad for her friend and tried to help him. She told her mom about the ball and how he could play with her.
Their mom took off the ball and gave Lucy a stick. She gave it to her and she went outside. She dropped a big, yellow ball in the yard and took it back to her house. Lucy and Sam played with the ball all day with the big, red ball.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little bush. The bush was happy because it had many friends. They would walk and play together.
One day, the bush started to rotting. It was now smaller and smaller and smaller and smaller than the other one! The bush was not happy. It wanted to help the bush, but it was too small.
The bush said, "I tried! I will give you a wish." The bush thought for a moment and said, "Yes, please help the bush." So, the bush and the bush shared a fun dress and played together in the garden.
The bush and the bush became the best of friends. They lived in the peaceful forest, and the bush was happy.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his ball, especially on the ground. One day, Tim found a weird object hiding in the sand. It was a big, red ball, and it made him very happy.
Tim played with the ball all day long. He would roll it, jump over it, and laugh with it. He had so much fun with his new ball and his friends. As the sun went down, Tim and his friends took turns playing with the ball.
When it was time for bed, Tim and his friends went back to their homes. They played with the ball and had a good time. They knew they would always remember their amazing day in the park. And Tim always remembered to remember his ball, so he had a new friend to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to eat cereal every morning. Lucy was a very brave girl who liked to try new things.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. He had many cars, but his favorite one was a red one. He liked to make the cars go fast and make loud noises. Tim was very happy when his cars were fast.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to bake. One day, he wanted to make a big cake for his mom's birthday. He was very excited.
Tim found a big bowl and put all the things he needed in it. He mixed and mixed until it was all gone. Then, he put the cake in the oven. While he waited, he played with his toys.
When the cake was done, Tim took it out of the oven. It was big and smelled so good. He called his mom to come and eat it. They both smiled and said "thank you" to Tim for the yummy cake.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty box with a lock on it. Inside the box, there was a colorful pen. Lily loved to draw and write with her pen.
One day, Lily found her friend, Tim, trying to open her box. "I can't open it," said Lily. "Can you help me?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, I can open it!" They tried and tried, but the box would not open.
Lily and Tim were sad. They couldn't open the box. Just then, a kind fairy appeared. "I can help you open the box," said the fairy. She waved her wand and the box opened! Lily and Tim were so happy. They thanked the fairy and continued to draw and write.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to dance and play all day. She was very flexible and could bend and twist in many ways. One day, Lucy found a big book with many spells. The spells were pretty and had many colors.
Lucy wanted to dance in the spell book. She tried to spell a spell, but she did not know how. Lucy felt sad and did not know what to do. She wanted to learn the spells so bad.
Then, Lucy had an idea. She asked her mom for help. Her mom read the spell to Lucy. Lucy was very happy. She danced in the spell book and had a lot of fun. Lucy learned that even if you are not flexible, a little bit of magic can make you feel better.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a young bush. The bush was happy because it had many friends. They would play together every day.
One day, the young bush saw a big bird. The bird was flying in the sky and it looked hungry. The bush wanted to help the bird, so it thought of a plan.
The next day, the young bush told its friends about the big bird. The friends were scared, but they stayed to help. They all worked together to make a big nest for the bird. The bird was happy and not hungry anymore.
The young bush and its friends were very proud of what they did. They learned that when they help each other, they can do big things. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable dog named Spot. Spot lived in a small house made of wood. He loved to play outside and run around in the sun.
One day, Spot's friend, a little bird named Chirpy, came to visit him. Chirpy said, "Spot, can I request a ride on your back?" Spot was happy and said, "Yes, Chirpy, you can ride on my back, but be careful."
Chirpy climbed on Spot's back, and they went for a ride in the sky. They flew over trees, houses, and even a big pond. They had so much fun together. Chirpy was happy to have a dependable friend like Spot. They played until the sun went down, and then went home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toy cars. One day, he found a big box. The box was heavy. Tim thought, "I can make this box go away."
Tim tried to push the heavy box with his hands. But the box was too big. He asked his friend, Sam, to help. Sam said, "I can help, but you must be patient." Tim said, "Yes, I will be patient."
Sam pushed the heavy box with all his might. The box went into the air. The box did not go away. It fell back down. Tim and Sam were happy. They played with the cars all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with blocks. She had many blocks in different colors. She liked to build big towers with her blocks.
One day, Lily wanted to build the biggest tower ever. She started to build it very fast. But, Lily ran out of blocks. She felt embarrassed because she couldn't make the tower as fast as she wanted it to. Lily had an idea.
Lily started to build the tower again. This time, she used all her blocks. She put one block on top of another, making the tower look bigger and faster. Lily was so happy to see her tower grow. She played with her tower all day long, and it was the best tower ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a new toy. It was a pretty doll with long hair. The doll had a big smile when she hugged it. Lucy loved her new doll very much.
One day, Lucy took her doll to the park. She put the doll on the grass and started to play. But then, something unexpected happened. The doll got a tear in its hair and its face changed. It looked very different now.
Lucy was sad because her doll's face was not perfect anymore. She told her mom what happened. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lucy. We can fix it." They went home and found some tape. They put the tape on the tear, and the doll's face turned back to normal. Lucy was happy again and played with her doll all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia liked to play outside in the sun. One day, she saw a big, pretty flower. It was a poppy. Mia wanted to pick the poppy, but it was too high for her.
Mia asked her friend, Tom, "Can you help me get the poppy?" Tom said, "Yes, I can help you." Tom was very tall. He reached up and picked the poppy for Mia. But then, a big bird came and took the poppy away. Tom and Mia were sad.
Tom had an idea. He said, "Let's make a big net to catch the bird." They found some sticks and made a net. They threw the sticks at the bird. The bird flew away, and they caught it! They were happy and proud.
The moral of the story is that when we work together, we can solve problems.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He liked to play with his toy car. One day, Tom saw a shiny medal on the table. He wanted to play with it. But, his mom said, "No, Tom. That medal is for daddy's medal."
Tom was sad. He wanted the medal so much. But, his mom said, "You can play with your toy car if you want." Tom was very happy. He played with his toy car and the shiny medal.
Later, Tom saw his friend, Lily. They played together and had fun. Tom shared his toy car with Lily. They both liked the shiny medal. Tom was happy to accept the shiny medal. And they played together all day, having lots of fun.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old and loved to play outside. One day, she was playing in the garden when she noticed a big, yellow flower. She reached out to pick it up, but then the flower ran away.
Sarah started to cry. She wanted to find the flower so she chased it. The flower kept running and dancing until it disappeared into the bushes. Sarah was so sad.
Standing in the bushes was an old lady. She said to Sarah, "Don't worry, little one. If you want to keep trying, just try and resist the threat. That way, you'll realize the danger of picking the flower."
Sarah listened to the old lady. She took a deep breath and stepped into the bushes. Sure enough, she was able to resist the threat. She was so happy and thanked the old lady for helping her.
The old lady smiled at Sarah and said, "It's important to resist the threat if you don't, even if it seems like you can't resist!" Sarah nodded and went back to playing with her colorful flower.

Once upon a time, there was a small cat named Tiny. Tiny loved to play near the big tree in the park. One day, Tiny saw a little bird sitting on the tree branch. The bird looked sad.
Tiny asked the bird, "Why are you sad?" The bird replied, "I lost my favorite toy. It is a small, red ball." Tiny wanted to help the bird find its toy, so they went to look for it together.
They looked under the tree and behind the bushes. They even saw a big, disgusting bug. But the bird and Tiny worked together to find the toy. Just when they thought they found it, the bug jumped up and got the ball. The bird was so happy and said, "Thank you, Tiny and Tiny!" They both smiled and played together for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play hockey. He had a hockey stick and a ball. He played with his friends every day.
One day, Tim was playing hockey when a big, fearful dog came up to him. The dog looked at Tim and his friends. Tim was scared. He wanted to escape from the dog.
Tim's friends saw the dog and came to help. They all pushed the dog away from the hockey stick. The dog ran away, and they were happy. Tim and his friends could escape now. They went back to playing hockey and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Lily. She had a neighbor named Tom. Lily and Tom liked to play together. They had a big yard with lots of flowers.
One day, Lily found a pretty rock. She wanted to hang it on the wall. Lily asked Tom, "Can you help me hang the rock?" Tom said, "Yes, I will help you."
Lily helped Tom hang the rock on the wall. They were very happy. The neighbor said, "Thank you, Lily and Tom!" Lily and Tom smiled and played together all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in the park. One day, he saw a big dog. The dog was very old and had a terrible smell. Tim wanted to examine the dog.
Tim walked up to the dog and said, "Hi dog, why do you smell so terrible?" The dog looked at Tim and said, "I smelled bad and chased after bugs. It makes me feel bad."
Tim felt sad for the dog. He wanted to help the dog feel better. So, Tim and the dog went to find water for the dog. They found a big bowl of water near a tree.
Tim said to the dog, "Here, doggy, drink this water. It will help you feel better." The dog drank the water and started to feel better. The dog was not terrible anymore.
Tim and the dog became good friends. They played together in the park every day. And they both learned not to judge others by their noses.
